.circuit-cache/stage43/final-diagnostics.command_text:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
source /workspace/task-tools/kicad-10.0.6/env.sh
bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 design/architecture-278/implementation/stage43/b2-translation/mapping.py .circuit-cache/stage43-b2-exact-v2
mapping_status=$?
bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 design/architecture-278/implementation/stage43/b2-translation/native_identity.py .circuit-cache/stage43-b2-intended
identity_status=$?
printf 'mapping_status=%s native_identity_status=%s (both expected rejection, no candidate acceptance)\n' "$mapping_status" "$identity_status"
[[ "$mapping_status" == 1 && "$identity_status" == 1 ]]

.circuit-cache/stage43/mapping-final.sh.command_text:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
source /workspace/task-tools/kicad-10.0.6/env.sh
bash scripts/kicad/run.sh python3 design/architecture-278/implementation/stage43/b2-translation/mapping.py .circuit-cache/stage43-b2-exact-v2
status=$?
[[ "$status" == 1 ]] || exit 1
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='.circuit-cache/stage43-b2-exact-v2/mapping-audit.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
if d['exact_translation_verified'] or not d['pose_deviations'] or d['pad_count']!=115 or d['copper_count']!=1160:raise SystemExit('missing/unexpected mapping diagnostic')
print('Expected strict pose rejection confirmed by completed bound diagnostic')
PY
